47class CacFsm : public beerocks::beerocks_fsm<fsm_state, fsm_event> {

59 /* @brief Send switch channel request to the interface managed
60 * by this fsm according to the given parameters.
61 *
62 * @param channel The channel to switch to
63 * @param bandwidth The bandwidth to switch to

65 * nullptr if an error occurred.
66 */
67 std::shared_ptr<sSwitchChannelRequest>
68 send_switch_channel_request(uint8_t channel, beerocks::eWiFiBandwidth bandwidth);
69 bool send_cac_request(beerocks::AgentDB::sRadio *db_radio);
70 void reset();
71 bool is_timeout_waiting_for_switch_channel_report();
72 bool is_timeout_waiting_for_cac_termination();
73
74private:
75 // environment
76 TaskPoolInterface &m_task_pool;
77 BackhaulManager &m_backhaul_manager;
78 ieee1905_1::CmduMessageTx &m_cmdu_tx;
79
80 std::shared_ptr<sSwitchChannelRequest> m_first_switch_channel_request = nullptr;
81
82 // extracted form the request
83 std::string m_ifname;

85
86 // original values
87 uint8_t m_original_channel = 0;

89 uint16_t m_original_center_frequency = 0;
90 int8_t m_original_secondary_channel_offset = 0;
91
92 // max time to wait for switch channel
93 static constexpr std::chrono::seconds DEFAULT_WAIT_FOR_SWITCH_CHANNEL_REPORT{5};
94 std::chrono::seconds m_wait_for_switch_channel_report = DEFAULT_WAIT_FOR_SWITCH_CHANNEL_REPORT;
95
96 // the point in time we we started waiting for switch channel
97 std::chrono::time_point<std::chrono::steady_clock> m_switch_channel_start_time_point;
98
99 // max time to wait for cac termination
100 static constexpr std::chrono::seconds DEFAULT_MAX_WAIT_FOR_CAC_TERMINATION{10};
101 std::chrono::seconds m_max_wait_for_cac_termination = DEFAULT_MAX_WAIT_FOR_CAC_TERMINATION;
102
103 // the point in time we we started waiting for cac termination
104 std::chrono::time_point<std::chrono::steady_clock> m_terminate_cac_start_time_point;
105};
